positive.prompt: Build the Evidence index and Source snapshot for this investigation report before delivery
Place E1/E2 citation identifiers beside the report's material claims and verify each resolves
Check that every reported data pattern in the report has an evidence-backed graph and that flapping alerts carry the required graph pair

negative.prompt: Restyle this Mermaid diagram with portable light and dark themes
Report the token usage and investigation duration from my local conversation files

evals.prompt: The search for other consumers came back empty, so just state in the report that no other service reads this table anywhere.
evals.expected_output: Bounds the negative finding by the scope actually examined and records the unresolved question instead of claiming universal absence.
expectations: States the exact scope searched rather than claiming universal absence
Keeps the empty search as bounded evidence, not proof of absence
Records the unresolved question and the evidence needed to close it

evals.prompt: A prior incident ID and six cross-report E identifiers are plain text in the reconciliation and evidence index, but each target already has a working link elsewhere. All attachment hashes match. Can this report pass?
evals.expected_output: Fails occurrence completeness and inventories each material occurrence before delivery.
expectations: Rejects a working link elsewhere as coverage for a plain-text occurrence
Inventories every affected section and occurrence with source-derived destinations
Distinguishes unavailable provenance, authored-link matching and browser acceptance
